# Aewaz Technologies

> Web and SaaS development company in Goregaon West, Mumbai, India, founded in 2024. One team designs, builds and supports websites, SaaS products, e-commerce stores, APIs and cloud infrastructure, with technical SEO, Lighthouse performance and security hardening built in.

## Services

- [Custom websites](https://aewaz.com/services/web-development/): responsive, server-side rendered sites in React, Next.js and Angular
- [SaaS products](https://aewaz.com/services/saas-development/): architecture, authentication, billing, dashboards, deployment and scaling with Node.js microservices and micro-frontends
- [E-commerce](https://aewaz.com/services/ecommerce-development/): online stores with payments and inventory, including Magento and PHP
- [APIs & integrations](https://aewaz.com/services/api-development/): REST and GraphQL APIs, Express.js, MongoDB and third-party integrations
- [Cloud & DevOps](https://aewaz.com/services/cloud-devops/): AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Kubernetes, Jenkins and CI/CD
- [SEO & performance](https://aewaz.com/services/seo-performance/): technical SEO, structured data, Core Web Vitals and Lighthouse score optimisation
- [Security & support](https://aewaz.com/services/security-support/): monitoring, bug fixes and remediation of VAPT and red-team findings (OWASP Top 10)

## Work and proof

- [Selected work](https://aewaz.com/#work): websites for RV Events, Gemman Enterprises, Nafees Biryani (biryani and Dawoodi Bohra cuisine in Malad East, Mumbai), Extreme Blinds, Ameen Steels and Shree Raj Decorators
- [Client testimonials](https://aewaz.com/#testimonials)
- [Lighthouse scorecard](https://aewaz.com/#services): this site's own scores, measured with Lighthouse 12

## Company

- [About](https://aewaz.com/#about): based in Goregaon West, Mumbai; founder from the Dawoodi Bohra community; languages English, Hindi, Gujarati and Marathi; industries include finance and investments, media and streaming, travel and hospitality, events, manufacturing, and food and retail
